author: Axiom III
title: Averaged MoE Baseline 2: RNN-Only Expert
abstract: This is the second of two baseline experiments to support the publication of the 'Averaged MoE' architecture. This submission isolates the RNN-only expert (GRU) from the Averaged MoE, using the same DSConv backbone and post-aggregator projection layers. The result will provide a controlled comparison to quantify the synergistic benefit of the averaging technique.
